correctness.rationale: For the exact finite graph with 24 arcs, complete enumeration of all arc subsets up to cardinality four gives (1,24,192,600,600) augmented faces; no five-arc face is possible because two hubs each have in/out capacity one. An explicit 624-pair face matching has all 4608 Hasse cover arrows topologically sorted after reversing matched incidences, proving acyclicity. Only 169 three-cells remain after removing the augmented empty pair, plus one vertex. Forman gives wedge 169 S^3 integrally. Independent mod-two and mod-three chain ranks agree. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces for each of 11 S6 cycle types, with independently checked Murnaghan-Nakayama character orthogonality, give the stated exact Specht multiplicities. All computations were run from the actual included scripts with deterministic digests.

value.rationale: The six-leaf complete bipartite digraph is the first uncomputed adjacent width beyond the known small Moore-space examples at widths four and five, making its torsion status and full topological type a motivated boundary problem. A verified collapse to 169 integral three-spheres resolves that exact natural invariant, while the complete nontrivial eight-constituent S6 character encodes all leaf symmetries of top homology, not determined by a Betti number. This is a finite structural homotopy and representation result; no all-width assertion or unsupported downstream claim is made.
